test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.**

Watching one’s pet cat is therapeutic and can make one quite ________ to the real world outside.
solution: The correct answer is '**oblivious**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**oblivious**'. • It means **'not noticing or realizing what is happening around you'.** (आस-पास होने वाली घटनाओं से बेख़बर) • *Example: She was completely **oblivious** of all the trouble she had caused.* • If we are **oblivious** to something or oblivious of it, we are not aware of it. • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.** **Correct Sentence:__*** Watching one's pet cat is therapeutic and can make one quite __**oblivious**__ to the real world outside.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **envious**: wanting something that somebody else has. (दूसरे के पास जो वस्‍तु है उसका इच्‍छुक) • **studious**: (used about a person) spending a lot of time studying. [(व्यक्ति) अध्‍ययन में काफ़ी अधिक समय लगाने वाला; अध्‍ययनशील] • **obvious**: easily seen or understood; clear. (जो आसानी से दिखाई दे या समझ में आए; स्‍पष्‍ट) 34:Ta4c, The correct answer is '**Difficult**'.
